title: SignalWell Contract-to-Policy Schema
description: XFed contract-to-policy output. Enforceable rules use ODRL 2.2 terminology and the IDS Usage Control style. Energy-domain legal metadata is represented with OSDU LegalTag and record-level legal field names. XFed traceability remains separate from the ODRL policy.

contract_id.description: XFed source contract identifier, preserved across preprocessing stages.

osdu.description: Optional OSDU-aligned legal metadata. XFed keeps OSDU metadata separate from ODRL policy rules: legalTag follows the OSDU Legal Service LegalTag shape, while legal follows the OSDU record-level legal metadata shape. Populate only values supported by the contract or trusted external metadata; deployment-specific allowed values must be validated against the target OSDU data partition.

@context.description: ODRL JSON-LD context plus IDS namespaces used by IDS Usage Control examples.

@type.description: ODRL Agreement: rules granted between assigner and assignee parties.

profile.description: ODRL profile identifier used in IDS Usage Control examples.

uid.description: Stable rule identifier used for XFed traceability and review.

assigner.description: ODRL Party granting the Permission; in an XFed data-sharing contract this may be the data holder.

assignee.description: ODRL Party receiving the Permission; in an XFed data-sharing contract this may be the data user.

action.description: Single atomic ODRL/IDS action, e.g. use, read, derive, distribute, or execute.

uid.description: Optional ODRL identifier for this Constraint.

leftOperand.description: ODRL/IDS left operand, e.g. purpose, recipient, spatial, dateTime, elapsedTime, or an IDS-specific term.

operator.description: ODRL/IDS operator, e.g. eq, neq, lt, lteq, gt, gteq, isA, isAllOf, isAnyOf, isNoneOf, or isPartOf.

rightOperand.description: Value compared with the left operand. Kept JSON-generic so literals, identifiers, or lists can be represented.

dataType.description: Optional datatype for the right operand, following ODRL terminology.

unit.description: Optional unit for the right operand, following ODRL terminology.

constraint.description: ODRL Constraints that must be satisfied for the Permission.

target.description: ODRL target Asset when the Duty applies to a specific Asset.

$comment: Standards alignment: ODRL = policy rules; OSDU = legal/compliance metadata. See STANDARDS_ALIGNMENT.md.

osduLegalTag.description: OSDU Legal Service LegalTag-shaped metadata candidate. Exact OSDU field names are preserved. XFed permits evidence-supported partial properties at generation time to avoid hallucination; a LegalTag must be completed and validated against the target OSDU partition before API creation.

name.description: OSDU LegalTag name (3-100 alphanumeric/hyphen characters). OSDU prefixes the data-partition name when the LegalTag is created.

properties.description: OSDU LegalTag properties. Only populate contract-supported or trusted external values during XFed policy generation.

countryOfOrigin.description: OSDU countryOfOrigin using ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes.

contractId.description: OSDU contractId: actual contract identifier, 'Unknown', or 'No Contract Related'.

expirationDate.description: OSDU expirationDate in yyyy-MM-dd format when supplied; empty is allowed where OSDU permits no explicit expiration.

dataType.description: OSDU dataType. Allowed values can be data-partition specific.

originator.description: OSDU originator: client, supplier, or other data originator.

exportClassification.description: OSDU exportClassification. Deployment-specific allowed values must be validated against the target OSDU partition.

osduRecordLegal.description: OSDU record-level legal metadata. This is distinct from the LegalTag definition: it associates a record with LegalTag names and other relevant data countries. The OSDU system-generated compliance status is intentionally omitted from XFed policy generation.

legaltags.description: Names of OSDU LegalTags associated with the record.

otherRelevantDataCountries.description: OSDU record-level otherRelevantDataCountries using ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes. This is not part of the LegalTag itself.
